messages:
Rhea: Heads-up: planning a small dedupe dry-run Friday 10:30am PT to identify duplicate contacts that skew healthscore. Need someone to run selector + export. :mag:

Diego: I can run it. Proposed filter: same normalized email OR (same phone AND name fuzzy). Exclude support_inbound < 14d and trial accounts. Sample 150.

Priya: Add guard: do not suggest merges where both contacts have product_events_last_30d > 3. We don't want to collapse active users. Also skip contacts with `legal_representative` tag.

Diego: SQL preview:
```sql
SELECT c1.id AS a, c2.id AS b, c1.account_id, c1.owner_id, c2.owner_id
FROM crm.contacts c1
JOIN crm.contacts c2 ON c1.account_id = c2.account_id AND c1.id < c2.id
WHERE (lower(regexp_replace(c1.email,'\\+.*@','@')) = lower(regexp_replace(c2.email,'\+.*@','@'))
  OR (c1.phone = c2.phone AND levenshtein(lower(c1.name), lower(c2.name)) < 5))
  AND c1.last_inbound_at < now() - interval '14 days'
  AND c2.last_inbound_at < now() - interval '14 days'
LIMIT 150;
```

Marta: We'll write suggestions to `crm.suggested_merges` and surface them in CS console as non-destructive proposals. Do not auto-merge. Also create `health_score_effective` that hides in UI only.

Rhea: Good. Ops: ensure suggested merges are excluded from billing exports. Elena flagged that earlier.

ops-bot: scheduled job 'dedupe-dryrun' queued for 2026-01-10T17:30:00Z

Priya: ran selector and uploaded sample CSV to /shared/cs/dedupe/samples/sample_1758502468.csv. Found 6 ownerless contacts -> added to unowned queue.

Diego: Marked 20 pairs as high-confidence. Tagged owners with notification but rate-limited to 1/msg per 12h.

Marta: I'll draft runbook blurb and dashboard tooltip: 'Suggested merges are proposals. Approve to commit; merges affect touch attribution.' Putting confluence link when done.

Rhea: Thanks all. Quick sync 10:20am PT tomorrow to sanity-check before the run. :white_check_mark:
